lines.say: Over 77,000 stars. / Number one / on GitHub Trending.
Archify turns any idea, / plan or codebase / into an interactive diagram.
One prompt: / draw the architecture / of this project. / It reads 1,671 files, / validates, renders / and runs a browser check.
Under the hood, / your words become / typed JSON. / Validators and layout rules / check it, / and only a passing / diagram ships.
Explain an agent workflow. / Follow a cache miss. / Explore service relationships.
Point it at a repo / and ask for / 8 to 12 core components, / one primary path / and trust boundaries. / The result: / a source-backed system map.
Five diagram types: / architecture, workflow, / sequence, data flow / and lifecycle.
Then refine it / in chat: / add Redis, / move auth / to the left, / highlight the rollback path.
Every diagram is explorable: / focus a node, / trace downstream, / probe a route.
Download it. / Open it. / One self-contained HTML file. / Send it to anyone, / no install needed.
And it's checked: / the Proof Lab holds / all 11 scenarios, / their JSON sources / and validation receipts.
It works with / Claude Code, Codex, / Cursor and OpenCode. / One line installs it.
